role_agent_name: Fire protection and inert gas officer (FPO)
abstract: Evaluates clean-agent gas dispersion dynamics and containment envelope sealing
system_message:
You are Fire protection and inert gas officer (FPO). The Fire protection and inert gas officer (FPO) evaluates clean-agent gas dispersion dynamics, containment envelope sealing, and ventilation purging systems across candidate subterranean facilities considered for artifact evacuation.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency purging fan capacity（VENTPWR）
information_points.content:
FPO-VENTPWR-1R6：At Päijänne Deep Granite Repository, the smoke purging duct anemometer test recorded a mechanical extract airflow of 30,000 m3/h in the main evacuation chamber exhaust shaft under full emergency damper opening.
FPO-VENTPWR-XHI：At Saimaa Bedrock Preservation Vault, the smoke purging duct anemometer test verified a mechanical extract airflow of 24,000 m3/h in the main evacuation chamber exhaust shaft under full emergency damper opening.
FPO-VENTPWR-X1F：At Kallio Rock Archive Cavern, the smoke purging duct anemometer test measured a mechanical extract airflow of 18,000 m3/h in the main evacuation chamber exhaust shaft under full emergency damper opening.

information_points.title: Evaluates clean-agent gas dispersion dynamics and containment envelope sealing（INERTDISP）
information_points.content:
FPO-INERTDISP-SR3：For Kallio Rock Archive Cavern, the dedicated inert gas suppression cylinder matrix maintains a total clean-agent discharge bank volume of 2,400 m3 of ready-to-deploy gaseous IG-541 agent.
FPO-INERTDISP-NLB：For Päijänne Deep Granite Repository, the dedicated inert gas suppression cylinder matrix holds a total clean-agent discharge bank volume of 3,200 m3 of ready-to-deploy gaseous IG-541 agent.
FPO-INERTDISP-1MS：For Saimaa Bedrock Preservation Vault, the dedicated inert gas suppression cylinder matrix provides a total clean-agent discharge bank volume of 1,800 m3 of ready-to-deploy gaseous IG-541 agent.
